passives.name: StarrkEquipmentPassive1
passives.description:
On the 5th $Attack of each cycle performed through $StarrkPassive1:
- Spawn {1} $StarrkWolves (Capacity: {2})

$StarrkWolf:
- Spawns next to this unit’s position
- Has {3}% of this unit’s damage 
- Applies $ManaBurn for {4}% of its damage

On $Attack:
- $StarrkWolf deletes itself
